transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I keep hearing things at work. I'm a nursing assistant, and lately, I've been hearing voices coming from the call-light speaker. And the hallway vents, too. They keep telling me exactly which patient records have been changed. 

It sounds as clear as somebody standing right next to me, talking right into my ear. But... the thing is, even when the unit is completely quiet, nobody else seems to hear it. So, that's why I'm here.
Have you been going through a period of feeling extremely high, unusually energetic, or so down that it lasted most of the day nearly every day?

Well, I wouldn't say "high," exactly. But... some days I do feel like I'm finally awake. Like I have all this energy and I'm meant to go in and fix everything at work. 

But the thing is, if my husband or one of the nurses tells me I need to slow down, I just snap at them. I get so irritated... because it feels like they're blocking something really important that I'm supposed to be doing. So I guess I have been unusually energetic, but it makes me pretty short-tempered with people.
Do you believe you have a special mission or unusual power to fix what’s going wrong at work?

Well, I don't know if I'd call it a special power, but... I do know I'm the only one seeing what's actually happening. 

Like with the wound-care charts. I know they're showing a pattern that management really doesn't want anyone to see. I brought it up, and my supervisor keeps trying to brush it off, telling me it's just late entries or, you know, coding mistakes. But I know better. I can tell they're watching exactly what I write down in the system now, because... well, because I'm the one who caught it. So, yes, I feel like it's my responsibility to do something about it.
When you're in those more energetic periods, do you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?

Actually, no. I haven't really noticed that. I mean... even when I have all that energy at work, I still try to get my normal amount of sleep. I don't feel like I can just go without it or anything. I still need my usual six or seven hours to feel rested, so... no, my sleep hasn't really changed much.
Before the voices started, had you recently had a seizure, head injury, or another medical illness?

No, nothing like that. I haven't had a seizure or hit my head or anything. I'm generally pretty healthy... physically, at least. So, no, there haven't been any other medical issues before all of this.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
They started about two months ago. It was right around the time they asked me to help lead the new wound-care documentation rollout at work. That's when I first started hearing them.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

Yeah, people at work have brought that up a few times lately. It's just... my mind keeps jumping around so fast. I'll go from thinking about the wound measurements to patient initials, and then to the dates on the forms, and then trying to figure out what it all means. 

It's honestly like ten tabs are open at once in my head, and none of them will close. So I guess when I try to talk, all of that just comes spilling out and they have a hard time keeping up with where my brain is going.
During this time, have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I haven't really felt depressed. Honestly, it's been the opposite. My energy has been so high with everything going on at work, and my brain just won't slow down. So, no, I haven't been feeling down or depressed.
Have the voices ever continued during a time when your energy and irritability were back to your usual normal?

No, they haven't. I never heard the call-light voices or... or saw those hidden messages in the charts before this whole thing started. It was only after I got so wound up about the new rollout, you know? That's when it all began. I was sleeping less, working nonstop, and just feeling so certain that I was the only one who could fix everything at the facility. So, no, I haven't heard them when I'm just feeling like my normal self. It's only been during this time.
Have the voices and these beliefs been going on for more than one month?

Yeah, it's been going on for about two months now. It all started right around the time they asked me to help lead the new wound-care documentation rollout at the facility. So, yeah, definitely more than a month.
